description: This file defines the Statistics controller class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It contains methods triggered by various events such as adding reviews, returns, and order history updates. The class interacts with models to update statistical data related to these events.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Controller class handling statistical updates for reviews, returns, and order status changes within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Increments the review count statistic after a review is added.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Increments the return count statistic after a return is added.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Updates order-related statistics based on changes in order status.
